newsitem.title: USA: Two earthquakes hit offshore California.
newsitem.headline: Two earthquakes hit offshore California.

text.p: Two earthquakes struck a little more than an hour apart offshore California late Thursday night, according to the California Institute of Technology (Caltech).
No injuries were reported although tremors were felt on shore from San Diego to Los Angeles, according to local news reports.
Caltech said the first quake occurred at 9:35 p.m. and was measured at about 4.5 on the open ended Richter scale. The second one occurred at 10:38 p.m. and measured 4.1.
The earthquakes occurred 10 miles northeast of San Clemente Island, which is about 60 miles northwest of San Diego.
